## Summary

Describe the focused change and the problem it addresses.

## Evidence boundary

State whether the change concerns a paper claim, verified fact,
counterexample, independent inference, proposed repair, open question, or only
presentation.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `make test`.
- [ ] I ran `make verify-results`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests when behavior changed.
- [ ] I explained and authenticated any changed published result.
- [ ] I checked that no credentials, private data, machine paths, or
      confidential employer information were added.
- [ ] I kept paper-literal behavior separate from proposed repairs.

## Additional context

Link the related issue, derivation, primary source, or reproduction output.
